subject: GCP co-sell: Quantaflow joint pipeline triage & handoff checklist
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Li <ethan.li@quantaflow.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: GCP co-sell: Quantaflow joint pipeline triage & handoff checklist

Ethan,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team was impressed by the latency profile on batch extraction. We want to make sure the GCP co-sell handoff is tidy so we can remove friction on contracting and listing. Attaching an initial handoff checklist (draft).

Key asks for the first pass:
- Confirm internal procurement contact + PO cadence
- Current GCP marketplace listing status (alpha/beta/ready) and any blocking legal items
- Expected first production week and preferred region (us-central1/us-west1)
- Any security artifacts we should attach to the GCP listing (SOC2 snapshot, data flow diagram)

Proposed next step: 30-minute joint triage with GCP PM + our partner ops this Thursday or Friday. Vanessa, Karthik — can you join?

Attachments: Quantaflow-GCP-handoff-checklist-v1.xlsx (hand-off checklist, 2 pages)

Thanks,

Jonas Weber
Partner Manager, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: GCP co-sell: Quantaflow joint pipeline triage & handoff checklist

Jonas —

Appreciate the checklist and the clear asks. A few quick notes before the triage:
- Procurement: our procurement lead is Maria Gomez (maria.gomez@quantaflow.ai). We usually run net-30 for first-year pilots; can provide PO on request.
- Marketplace state: Listing is in GCP partner console, currently in "partner review" stage. Priya from GCP is copied — she can share the outstanding checklist items on her side.
- Security artifacts: we have SOC2 Type II report (Q2 2026) and a high-level data flow diagram; I'll attach a PDF of the procurement contacts and SOC2 pointer.
- Region: us-west1 preferred for our initial users.

Thursday looks tight; Friday 11:00am PT / 2:00pm ET would work for our engineering lead and Priya.

On the checklist, can we add: billing contact, expected monthly token volume range, and an item for marketplace billing SKU mapping? That will speed up quoting.

Thanks,

Ethan Li
Head of Partnerships, Quantaflow
ethan.li@quantaflow.ai | +1 (650) 555-0211

Thanks, Ethan — good context. Adding a few pieces from partner ops perspective:

- Billing contact: please add the person who will receive marketplace invoices (name + email). GCP requires SKU mapping upfront for the listing to pick up billing correctly.
- Quoting: we'll need expected monthly token ranges (low/nominal/high) to size dedicated vs hosted recommendations in our proposal.
- SLA expectations: do you have an internal SLA we should surface to GCP for co-sell conversations? If not, we can propose Redwood standard SLOs for the pilot.
- Legal: if there are special IP or indemnity asks, flag them now so our legal and GCP can triage.

I can join Friday at 11:00am PT. Grace — can you confirm whether the canary account (us-west1) is already provisioned for this partner? Karthik, please bring the listing readiness checklist (we need to confirm labeling, SKU mapping, and audit artifact uploads).

Thanks — I'll update the checklist with the billing and SLA fields and re-upload to the shared drive.

Vanessa Ortiz
